title: Snapshot transports before awaiting writer drains
answers: Why can draining pending connection writes fail when transports change?
How should ConnectionHandler.drain_writers handle concurrent transport changes?
How do I avoid dictionary mutation errors while draining proxy output?
body:
Symptom: Draining pending connection writes can fail when transports change concurrently.
Root cause: mitmproxy/proxy/server.py:ConnectionHandler.drain_writers iterated the live transports dictionary across an await of writer.drain().
Fix pattern: Snapshot the dictionary values into a list before iterating across awaits; retain the drain lock and the writer-is-not-None guard.
Constraints: Applies when a mutable dictionary may change while iteration is suspended; the snapshot stabilizes iteration membership, not the state of individual transports.
